artifact.name: MakeLark Studio homepage
artifact.surface: One production marketing homepage with an explicitly illustrative native product demo
artifact.scope: Build only the homepage. Select the concept under delegated creative authority. No ChatGPT Sites.
required_states: Early-access contact action, validation and honest outcome

product_truth.audience: Owners of businesses that need professional website creation and an easier way to keep their website current; initial contexts include automotive, accounting, real estate, law, manufacturing, and restaurants.
product_truth.primary_job: Understand MakeLark Studio, see a concrete website-improvement workflow, and request early access.
required_content: MakeLark is the parent company and MakeLark Studio is the product
Website creation, visual feedback, ongoing updates, and managed hosting are the product scope
Studio is in development / early access
Northline Homes and business photography are illustrative examples
fixed_strings: A simpler way to run it.
prohibited_inventions: Live site publishing from the demo
An account or saved project when only local demo state exists
A successful server submission without a working endpoint
Fictional example businesses presented as actual customers
functional_requirements: Native, selectable content and semantic controls
One request -> updated preview -> original/updated comparison -> local approval loop
Mobile menu, disclosure controls, forms, copy actions and demo controls work if shown
Email or other contact handoff accurately describes its actual behavior

creative_direction.core_idea: The working Studio: make a useful business-website change visible in the product itself.
creative_direction.composition: Strong outcome headline and two actions above one dominant workspace. Website preview occupies approximately 70% of its desktop frame and a request/review panel occupies 30%. Supporting sections vary between editorial text, business imagery, and a continuous workflow.
creative_direction.geometry: Rectangular page and workspace geometry, 1px dividers, restrained 6-12px corner radii, aligned 1160-1280px content widths.
creative_direction.material: Flat white and near-white software surfaces with a single subtle workspace shadow. Photographic texture is confined to business examples.
creative_direction.typography: Self-hosted Manrope. Major headings 800; section headings 700; actions 600; body 400-500. Desktop hero approximately 64-80px, line-height 1.08-1.15, modest negative tracking. Body approximately 18-20px.
creative_direction.color_strategy: Preserve #F8F9FC canvas, #FFFFFF surfaces, #141827 ink, #5662EC action blue, #E9EDFC selected state, #5D667A secondary text, and #DFE3ED dividers. Blue identifies actions and relevant state.
creative_direction.image_language: Existing generated business photographs provide credible context inside fictional examples. The house at dusk anchors the real-estate product demonstration.
creative_direction.density: Calm headline area followed by an information-rich but readable product surface. Supporting sections stay concise; avoid repeating boxed feature grids.

signature_moves: A native request -> compare -> approve loop changes an actual website example while the owner keeps the same visual context.

experience_composition.exposure_frequency: First-time product discovery with short repeat visits
experience_composition.task_criticality: Clear product understanding and a truthful early-access action
experience_composition.production_budget: Reuse available code, original brand assets and business images. No paid asset generation or new service purchase.
protected_qualities: Visible website outcome inside a recognizable software workspace
Large architectural image with readable native text

signature_experience.experience_promise: A business owner can see how a simple request changes the website before choosing whether to keep it.
signature_experience.defining_moment: Request a private viewing action; the example website updates, original/updated comparison remains available, and approval produces a local-demo confirmation.
signature_experience.design_integration: The same business website is the main image, mechanism explanation and interactive proof. Main marketing actions remain accessible beside the demonstration.
may_simplify: Additional industry switches when they do not have faithful examples
Secondary visual details below the main workflow
signature_experience.first_proof: design/studies/studio.webp and studio-updated.webp: actual rendered composition and native request/preview state. Final implementation behavior has separate audited proof.

anti_patterns: Abstract sculpture or unrelated visual world in place of product explanation
Fake customer logo strips, metrics or testimonials
Agency portfolio or template marketplace presentation as the main product identity
A wall of identically sized rounded feature cards
Unbounded autoplay, scroll hijacking or timed choreography
Dead CTA, pricing, login, social or legal links

token_sources: User-supplied makelark-brand-and-storyboard.html (source asset guide, not included)
platform_conventions: Recognizable header navigation and mobile menu
allowed_deviations: Use a fictional Northline Homes example with existing property imagery
Local CSS refinements without replacing the identity

roles: Make the fictional business website tangible
Show breadth of business context without fabricating delivered customer work
asset_constraints: Use exact existing guide assets or documented derivations
Do not represent fictional people/businesses as actual customers
Images have descriptive alt text when meaningful

roles: Brief feedback for a user-triggered state change
motion.reduced_motion: Honor prefers-reduced-motion. Remove nonessential transitions and smooth scrolling while preserving every control, state and confirmation.
performance_constraints: No long simulated AI typing or waiting

avoid: AI hype without a concrete action
character_constraints: Hero headline remains a short two-part statement
Paragraphs should be readable on a phone
legal_or_exact_copy: A disclosure that Studio is in development
A disclosure that the interactive example does not publish a real site

keyboard_and_focus: All interactive controls reachable by keyboard
Announce changed demo status without stealing focus
contrast_and_text: Native text rather than image text
No required information conveyed only by color
No horizontal page overflow at target widths
touch_and_pointer: Demo panel reflows instead of being scaled down to unreadable text

repository_constraints: Do not modify unrelated existing client demos
performance: Load secondary assets after primary content where practical
No external tracker or model invocation required for the demo

core_workflow: Reach early-access contact and understand what happens next

evidence_notes.stage: Production marketing homepage; explicitly illustrative product demo, not a production Studio product.
evidence_notes.studies: Three desktop hero studies and one updated state captured and visually inspected on 2026-10-23 UTC.
evidence_notes.threshold: critic_threshold is an acceptance target, not an observed quality score.
evidence_notes.final_checks: Final homepage implementation checks and independent critique belong to the root's source-bound proof, not these concept studies.
